[/s]A seasonal medieval tiny shed that can be purchased from Robin as a standalone building.

It can also be upgraded (twice) to have a larger interior. [img]https://i.imgur.com/UXyDPiq.png[/img] It's bigger on the inside!

The shed has more accurate ambience lighting compared to vanilla buildings and will become slightly dark inside when it is raining outside, and very dark inside when it is night time unless there are light sources placed inside. 🌧🌙🔆

Inspired by Inmognito's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16246]Little Shed for Solid Foundations[/url]﻿ mod. ♡

If you would like to have variety with the appearance of your shed please check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31993](AT) Medieval Tiny Shed Retextures[/url]﻿ mod. ♡

The mod will detect what recolour you have installed and apply it automatically for both the exterior and interior.

You can manually change the exterior and interior recolour in the config options if you wish using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, or opening and editing the config.json file that generates in the mod folder after first launch of the game when the mod is installed.
If you decide to change your options through the config.json, please see the Readme file included in the mod folder or this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2024]Article[/url]﻿﻿﻿﻿ for config option names.
